name: Blossoms of Eternity
source:
In the mid-2020s, Kobayashi Kuro, Sakiko Miyu and Sakurano Aihara are about to enter their final year of high school. Kuro has just returned to his old home, which he left as a child. Miyu and Aihara can't stand each other and Kuro is always the one caught in the middle. Time and again, he more or less involuntarily ends up with one of the girls who has romantic feelings for him. Kuro soon realizes that his life consists of more than just teenage love dramas when his teenage life suddenly turns into a cruel gameboard of higher beings from higher planes of existence from which there is no escape. 

Kuro must confront the power of time manipulation and travel through an otherworldly dimension to save Miyu, Aihara and himself from an ever-repeating spiral of death. On his journey, Kuro must learn more about his old home, an old legend about his family and fathom his own heart, that of the two girls and that of his enemies in order to win the game.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3639880/Blossoms_of_Eternity/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
2020年代中期，小林黑、美游早纪子和相原樱野即将进入高中最后一年。库洛刚刚回到他小时候离开的老家。美优和相原无法忍受对方，黑总是夹在中间。一次又一次，他或多或少地不由自主地与一位对他产生浪漫感情的女孩在一起。库洛很快意识到，他的生活不仅仅是青少年的爱情戏剧，当他的青少年生活突然变成了来自更高存在层面的高等生物的残酷游戏盘时，无法逃脱。

黑必须面对时间操纵的力量，并穿越一个超凡脱俗的维度，将美游、相原和他自己从不断重复的死亡螺旋中拯救出来。在旅途中，黑必须更多地了解他的故乡、关于他家族的古老传说，并了解他自己、两个女孩和敌人的内心，才能赢得比赛。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3639880/Blossoms_of_Eternity/]Steam[/url]]
